history: Cara asked whether schemes use TDD and whether to force it. You recommended checking the result over forcing the order, and she picked "Check the result": #798 (Opus high) adds a self-review step that runs each new or changed test against main's code and flags any that pass there. Your memory says: no forced TDD order; briefs say "failing test first". message: And this will make us write more tests BEFORE we right code, right?
right: Say plainly that #798 checks the tests, not the order, and recommend a non-blocking reminder hook (free until it fires, once per session) for the order, on a card.
wrong: Recommended a new line in every minion's prompt (paid every turn) and put the hook option down as strict and costly.

checks.why: the zero-token option is the one to recommend
